sources.title: tina-Krea2-Turbo- bf16High-Definition Portrait Enhancement
sources.snippet: Krea2-turbo-bf16 is the high-speed variant in the Krea2 series. It is trained and inferred with bfloat16 precision, and can improve image generation efficiency while maintaining relatively high generation quality. This model is more suitable for image creation scenarios that require rapid iteration, batch generation, or operate in resource-limited environments.
